data.title: Sector Snapshot: Construction Robotics Funding Soars To $1.6B, Tripling Previous Peak
data.description: Companies spanning construction and robotics have raised about $1.6 billion so far this year  — more than 4x the $389 million recorded in all of 2025 — according to Crunchbase data. The surge was driven by three companies that raised the majority of the funding.
data.author: Mary Ann Azevedo
